# GR Tiling & Bathroom Renovations

GR Tiling & Bathroom Renovations is a Dublin-based specialist in full bathroom renovations and professional tiling services. Founded and run by Gerard Ronan, the business serves homeowners across Dublin and surrounding areas. Known for clean work, honest pricing, and reliable timelines — no hidden costs, no surprises.

- Google rating: 5.0 stars

## Services

### Bathroom Renovations
Full bathroom renovation service including design, demolition, plumbing, tiling, and fitting. GR Tiling manages the full project from start to finish so homeowners only deal with one contractor. Specialisms include full bathroom strips and refits, ensuite renovations, wet room installations, and tiling and finishing work as part of a full renovation.

### Tiling Services
Professional tiling for residential properties across Dublin. Services include floor tiling, wall tiling, bathroom tiling, kitchen tiling, shower tiling, and tile repairs. Works with all tile types and formats including large-format tiles.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Dublin?**
The cost depends on the size of the bathroom, the layout, and the finishes chosen. A clear, upfront written quote is always provided before work begins, with no hidden costs.

**How long does a bathroom renovation take?**
Most bathroom renovations take between 1 to 2 weeks depending on size and complexity. A clear timeline is agreed before starting and adhered to.

**Do you cover all areas of Dublin?**
Yes. GR Tiling works across Dublin and nearby areas. Contact to confirm availability for a specific location.

**Can you handle just the tiling, not a full renovation?**
Yes. Both full bathroom renovations and standalone tiling services are available.

**Will the work area be kept clean?**
Yes. The site is tidied at the end of each day and left fully clean on completion.

**Do customers get a written quote?**
Yes. Every project comes with a written quote outlining the scope, timeline, and cost before any work begins.

## About the Business

GR Tiling & Bathroom Renovations is an Irish-owned and operated business run by Gerard Ronan. The company is fully insured and offers free quotes. The business differentiates itself through transparent pricing, clean workmanship, and reliable scheduling — common pain points for homeowners dealing with renovation contractors in Dublin.
